status_taxonomy.CLOSED_EXACT: The exact tested recipe, split, feature set, postprocess, and gate is closed. The broader model class is not closed.
status_taxonomy.INVALID_TECHNICAL: No scientific conclusion is admissible because execution, schema, dependency, or observability failed.
status_taxonomy.DISCOVERY_ONLY: Useful for mechanism discovery or lineage comparison, but not independently confirmed or submission-ready.
status_taxonomy.OLD_GATE_REJECTED: A positive or inconclusive signal was rejected by an old unsupported hard gate; only a frozen confirmation may reopen it.
status_taxonomy.CHECKPOINT_PEAK: A best intermediate checkpoint or selected point exists; it is preserved as a candidate, not treated as final-epoch evidence.
status_taxonomy.INFORMATION_POSITIVE: The result yielded verified directional information or a positive official/local mechanism signal; this is not automatically deployment readiness.
status_taxonomy.PROXY_EXPOSED: Selection/proxy evidence changed sign or materially weakened on a later sealed or official surface.

counting_rule: The four grains overlap and must never be summed as unique experiments. The exhaustive family denominator is 48.
